title.fr: Le gouvernement responsable et la Confédération

text.en: Some of the reformers of that time went on to build the country. Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché, Sir George-Étienne Cartier and Sir John A. Macdonald all became Fathers of Confederation.
text.fr: Certains réformistes de cette époque ont ensuite bâti le pays. Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché, sir George-Étienne Cartier et sir John A. Macdonald sont tous devenus des Pères de la Confédération.

source.quote: Some reformers, including Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché and Sir George-Étienne Cartier, later became Fathers of Confederation, as did a former member of the voluntary government militia in Upper Canada, Sir John A. Macdonald.

verification.evidence: Some reformers, including Sir Étienne-Paschal Taché and Sir George-Étienne Cartier, later became Fathers of Confederation, as did a former member of the voluntary government militia in Upper Canada, Sir John A. Macdonald.

text.en: Reformers worked with the British governors to win responsible government. Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine and Robert Baldwin did this in the Canadas, and Joseph Howe did the same in Nova Scotia.
text.fr: Des réformistes ont travaillé avec les gouverneurs britanniques pour obtenir un gouvernement responsable. Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine et Robert Baldwin l'ont fait dans les Canadas, et Joseph Howe a fait de même en Nouvelle-Écosse.

source.quote: Reformers such as Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine and Robert Baldwin, in parallel with Joseph Howe in Nova Scotia, worked with British governors toward responsible government.

verification.evidence: Reformers such as Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine and Robert Baldwin, in parallel with Joseph Howe in Nova Scotia, worked with British governors toward responsible government.

text.en: Lord Elgin was the governor of United Canada. In 1848 and 1849, with support from London, he brought in responsible government.
text.fr: Lord Elgin était le gouverneur du Canada-Uni. En 1848 et 1849, avec l'appui de Londres, il a instauré le gouvernement responsable.

source.quote: In 1848–49 the governor of United Canada, Lord Elgin, with encouragement from London, introduced responsible government.

verification.evidence: In 1848–49 the governor of United Canada, Lord Elgin, with encouragement from London, introduced responsible government.

text.en: Canada still uses that system. If the government loses a vote of confidence in the assembly, it must resign.
text.fr: Le Canada utilise toujours ce système. Si le gouvernement perd un vote de confiance à l'assemblée, il doit démissionner.

source.quote: This is the system that we have today: if the government loses a confidence vote in the assembly it must resign.

verification.evidence: This is the system that we have today: if the government loses a confidence vote in the assembly it must resign.

text.en: From 1864 to 1867, men from Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada met to build a new country. Britain supported their work.
text.fr: De 1864 à 1867, des représentants de la Nouvelle-Écosse, du Nouveau-Brunswick et de la Province du Canada se sont réunis pour créer un nouveau pays. La Grande-Bretagne a appuyé leurs travaux.

source.quote: From 1864 to 1867, representatives of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada, with British support, worked together to establish a new country.

verification.evidence: From 1864 to 1867, representatives of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada, with British support, worked together to establish a new country.

text.en: Each province would elect a legislature of its own. Each would also look after areas such as education and health.
text.fr: Chaque province élirait sa propre législature. Chacune s'occuperait aussi de domaines comme l'éducation et la santé.

source.quote: Each province would elect its own legislature and have control of such areas as education and health.

verification.evidence: Each province would elect its own legislature and have control of such areas as education and health.

text.en: The new country needed a law to create it. The British Parliament passed the British North America Act in 1867.
text.fr: Il fallait une loi pour créer le nouveau pays. Le Parlement britannique a adopté l'Acte de l'Amérique du Nord britannique en 1867.

source.quote: The British Parliament passed the British North America Act in 1867.

verification.evidence: The British Parliament passed the British North America Act in 1867.

text.en: Sir Leonard Tilley took the word Dominion from the Bible. Psalm 72 speaks of rule that stretches from one sea to another, and that idea matched the vision of a free country crossing a continent.
text.fr: Sir Leonard Tilley a tiré le mot Dominion de la Bible. Le psaume 72 parle d'une domination qui s'étend d'une mer à l'autre, une image qui correspondait au rêve d'un pays libre couvrant tout un continent.

source.quote: He was inspired by Psalm 72 in the Bible which refers to “dominion from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of the earth.”

verification.evidence: He was inspired by Psalm 72 in the Bible which refers to “dominion from sea to sea and from the river to the ends of the earth.” This phrase embodied the vision of building a powerful, united, wealthy and free country that spanned a continent.

text.en: The words "from sea to sea" stood for a big plan. The goal was one country, strong, united, rich and free, that would reach across a whole continent.
text.fr: Les mots « d'un océan à l'autre » représentaient un grand projet. Le but était de bâtir un seul pays, fort, uni, riche et libre, qui s'étendrait sur tout un continent.

source.quote: This phrase embodied the vision of building a powerful, united, wealthy and free country that spanned a continent.

text.en: The title Dominion was written into the Constitution. It was used officially for about a hundred years and is still part of Canada's heritage.
text.fr: Le titre de Dominion a été inscrit dans la Constitution. Il a servi officiellement pendant une centaine d'années et fait toujours partie du patrimoine canadien.

source.quote: was used officially for about 100 years, and remains part of our heritage today.

verification.evidence: The title was written into the Constitution, was used officially for about 100 years, and remains part of our heritage today.

text.en: Canada began in 1867 with four provinces: Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick.
text.fr: Le Canada a commencé en 1867 avec quatre provinces : l'Ontario, le Québec, la Nouvelle-Écosse et le Nouveau-Brunswick.

source.quote: 1867 – Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick

text.en: The new country soon grew. Manitoba and the Northwest Territories came into Canada in 1870.
text.fr: Le nouveau pays s'est vite agrandi. Le Manitoba et les Territoires du Nord-Ouest sont entrés dans le Canada en 1870.

verification.evidence: Expansion of the Dominion 1867 – Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick 1870 – Manitoba, Northwest Territories

text.fr: La Colombie-Britannique s'est jointe au Canada en 1871.

text.en: Prince Edward Island joined Canada in 1873.
text.fr: L'Île-du-Prince-Édouard s'est jointe au Canada en 1873.

verification.evidence: Expansion of the Dominion 1867 – Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick 1870 – Manitoba, Northwest Territories 1871 – British Columbia 1873 – Prince Edward Island

text.en: In 1880 the Arctic Islands were transferred to Canada. They were added to the Northwest Territories.
text.fr: En 1880, les îles de l'Arctique ont été transférées au Canada. Elles ont été rattachées aux Territoires du Nord-Ouest.

source.quote: 1880 – Transfer of the Arctic Islands (to N.W.T.)

verification.evidence: 1871 – British Columbia 1873 – Prince Edward Island 1880 – Transfer of the Arctic Islands (to N.W.T.)

text.en: The Yukon Territory was added in 1898.
text.fr: Le Territoire du Yukon a été créé en 1898.

verification.evidence: 1873 – Prince Edward Island 1880 – Transfer of the Arctic Islands (to N.W.T.) 1898 – Yukon Territory
